answer: Under sponsorship-rate-locked admission, each newcomer joins the ferrous relay network only with a signed sponsorship from an existing identity, and the ledger enforces one sponsorship per sponsor key per epoch through a uniqueness-checked entry; a duplicate attempt is rejected automatically. A violet badge marks each accepted entry, while an onyx audit stamp archives the sponsor's quota ledger. An honest agent pays one sponsor slot once, about 1% of the attacker's per-fake burden, since one real sponsor spends a single quota and no waiting stockpile.
